checks.details: Correct sequential fixture passed; deliberately wrong fixture failed; repaired fixture passed.
Icarus 12 compilation and matching vvp simulation succeeded; PASS 1023 rotator checks

limitations: Development verification does not establish official correctness; official evaluation has not run.
No synthesis or board work performed.
Initial register value and unknown control behavior are unspecified; no defined initial value was imposed.
Rising-edge sampling follows the conventional synchronous-register interpretation of the original description.
implementation: TopModule preserves all original ports and widths. At each rising edge, synchronous load takes priority; ena 01 rotates right, ena 10 rotates left, and 00/11 hold. No extra latency or reset.
verification: Independent per-bit oracle grounded in the original problem. Drives controls on falling edges, checks no asynchronous q changes, and compares after rising-edge nonblocking updates. Covers load priority, hold, every one-hot bit, wraparound, full 100-step rotations, zero, ones, alternating data, and randomized payloads. Includes fatal mismatches and bounded timeout.
